lessons: Citation ID suffix is page_object_id, not a leaf number.
Distinguish original image pixel coordinates from OCR rescaled layout coordinates.
P2 excerpt may be 150 characters even when real normalized_text is longer.
OCR char_count excludes whitespace: 188 and 202 are different count conventions, not lost text.
Do not reverse all OCR blocks: column body, cross-column inline annotations, and running title are mixed.
Never convert AI visual readings or CI PASS into human scholarly approval.
Use issue-limited review sidecars; keep raw SQLite, JPEG, OCR, frozen citations and prior PRs immutable.
